newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 28.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 28.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.46 (+0.08)

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd is expected to reveal on Tuesday details of a far-reaching review of its steel operations which includes the virtual closure of its Newcastle works, the Sydney Morning Herald reported. The newspaper said the winding down of the Newcastle works would be part of a plan to cut A$500 million in costs in the steel division over the next 18 months. BHP also said it was close to finalising a A$1.8 billion exit from its 36 percent stake in Foster's Brewing Group Ltd.

Lion Nathan Ltd said on Monday its share of the Australian data from March suggested its share of the Australian beer market had stabilised. "While annualised market share in Australia is 41.1 percent compared to 42.0 percent six months ago, March results indicate improved performance, particularly in New South Wales, and suggest that market share is stabilising," chief executive Douglas Myers said.

WMC Ltd could invest a further A$900 million to lift annual production at its Olympic Dam mine in South Australia to 350,000 tonnes of copper and 7,900 tonnes of uranium, the Adelaide Advertiser reported on Friday.

Pacific Dunlop Ltd said Monday that its protective products division had agreed to buy U.S. safety glove maker Golden Needles Knitting Inc for A$115 million, the Sydney Morning Herald and the Australian Financial Review reported.

Defiance Mills Ltd said on Thursday that Bunge Foods Queensland Pty Ltd would increase its takeover offer to A$2.00 per share from A$1.95 per share and make a special dividend payment of five cents per share. This would effectively give Defiance shareholders A$2.05 per share, the company said in a statement. Defiance directors recommended shareholders accept the offer.
